card.name: Just before a number in comparisons
card.fires_on: The word or symbol right before a numeric value in a comparison or count, such as "of", "=", "over", "approximately", or a minus sign. The number itself comes next.

modes.label: Sign or equals before value
modes.description: A minus sign or equals sign that comes right before a statistic.

modes.label: Hedge before a figure
modes.description: Words like "approximately" or "over" that qualify an amount about to be given.

modes.label: Gap before a number
modes.description: A space position just before a number of years, percent, or age.
